I was driving in traffic on March 24, 2024 near the main intersection in Pasadena when the car diretcly ahead of me
stopped suddenly. There was no brake light warning and no obvious reason for it, as far as I could see. I applied my
brakes as hard as I could, but there was not enough distance to stop, and my front bumper struck the rear of the
vehicle in front of me. Both cars were moving slowly at the time of impact. I pulled over, checked that everynoe was
able to move, and exchanged information with the other driver. Within an hour or so I began to feel stiffness and pain
in my neck and lower back. I am reporting these symptoms now and will seek medical evaluation as soon as

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
